title: Palindrome
statement: Implement `solve(text)`. Return 1 when the letters and digits, casefolded, form a palindrome. Ignore every other character. An empty selection is a palindrome and returns 1.

examples.input: text = "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"

hints: Keep characters that are alphanumeric, and casefold them.
Compare the sequence to its reverse.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The palindrome is on the filtered sequence, not on the raw string.

args.text: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

editorial: The palindrome is on the filtered sequence, not on the raw string. Spaces and punctuation would make a sentence fail even when the letters read the same backward. Two pointers on the filtered list, or a reverse compare, are both linear.
